caption: A clear drinking glass filled with water rests on a plain white surface, holding a yellow-and-black STAEDTLER pencil that leans against the rim so the submerged portion appears displaced and bent at the waterline. A small green logo box sits fixed in the upper-right corner throughout. In the left foreground an open hand extends three fingers horizontally toward the side of the glass, holding nearly still. The open hand drops and blurs out toward the lower-left, briefly leaving the glass without a foreground hand. A single index finger re-enters from the bottom-left and rises toward the right, settling into a pointing pose with its tip held in front of the glass aimed at the pencil near the waterline, drifting only slightly across that region. The glass, water level, and apparent refraction bend remain unchanged while this gesture plays out. The pointing finger withdraws back toward the lower-left, blurring as it moves away.
